items.title: Rio Metro Zero Emission Feasibility Study
items.description: Evaluates battery-electric, hydrogen fuel-cell, and compressed-natural-gas options for Rio Metro's revenue and support fleets, including vehicle availability, charging and fueling needs, facility constraints, energy modeling, capital schedules, operating costs, and lifecycle comparisons through 2040.
items.provenance_status: official Rio Metro publications page and byte-identical official file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 59-page PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; complete text extraction and tables of contents reviewed.
The study is the technical basis for the companion 2023 Zero Emission Transition Plan.

items.title: Rio Metro Zero Emission Transition Plan
items.description: Sets Rio Metro's path toward battery-electric and hydrogen vehicles through 2040, with fleet purchases, charging and fueling concepts at the Albuquerque rail yard and county facilities, utility coordination, funding, workforce training, and implementation priorities.
items.provenance_status: official Rio Metro publications page and byte-identical official file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 38-page PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; complete text extraction and tables of contents reviewed.
The plan satisfies the Federal Transit Administration transition-plan requirement for zero-emission grant applications.
